compute_precision_recall: compute precision and recall from detection scores, boolean labels, and ground truth count
compute_average_precision: compute average precision from precision and recall arrays using VOCdevkit definition
compute_cor_loc: compute CorLoc scores per class from ground truth image counts and correctly detected image counts
test_compute_precision_recall: test compute_precision_recall with sorted detection scores and true/false positive labels
review_compute_average_precision: review compute_average_precision to ensure precision does not decrease as recall decreases
